metadata.title: Clicked like a confused cat, somehow got 2 kills? Valorant just gave up logic!
metadata.description:
Me: no clue what’s happening
Enemy: probably uninstalling mid-breath
Valorant: handing out 2 kills like it’s a bug
Click if your aim’s as lost as mine!
